note: Questions that must be answered before a decision can be made. 'Known' lists what is verified (with source IDs). 'Missing' lists what is not. 'How to find it' lists the discovery step; each step is listed in Suggestions so it can be approved first.

questions.question: How long should the trip be: the 3-night window (Feb 15–18) or a 7-night stay?
questions.known: Preferred window is Mon Feb 15 to Thu Feb 18, 2027 (3 nights). Brief asks for 7-night totals and 1–2 weeks. Feb 15, 2027 is a federal holiday (S10).
questions.how_to_find: Owner decision. Once chosen, all price cells are re-pulled for that length.

questions.question: Which check-in and check-out dates should be priced (Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027 range)?
questions.known: Window is Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027 (brief). Example 7-night window: Feb 15–22 (used for lookups only).
questions.how_to_find: Owner decision. Some official booking engines show rates only inside a booking window, so exact dates are needed to check.

questions.question: What is the verified total price for a 7-night stay at each shortlisted hotel?
questions.known: Caesars resort fee is $62.30/night incl. tax (S08). The official booking page did not return Feb 2027 room rates (S08).
questions.missing: All room rates for Feb 2027; all other resort fees; taxes for every hotel.
questions.how_to_find: Run official booking-engine searches for the chosen dates on each hotel's official site, record the date/time of the search, and copy the total (rate + resort fee + tax). See Suggestion S-01.

questions.question: What is the cheapest time to book, and when should we book?
questions.known: Caesars offers 'Advanced Purchase Savings' up to 30% off for stays 30+ days ahead, terms apply (S09). Cosmopolitan offers an 'Advance Purchase Non-Refundable' rate type (S20). Caesars advertises '48-hour cancellation' with asterisked terms (S09).
questions.missing: Any official price history or trend for Feb 2027 stays. The current sources cannot answer 'cheapest time'.
questions.how_to_find: Track official rates for the chosen dates on a schedule and record them (S-01). Read each hotel's cancellation policy (S-03).

questions.question: What is the budget per night, and do we need a room type with a queen or larger bed and a private bathroom?
questions.known: Brief requires private bathroom and queen-or-larger bed. Requirement is not yet confirmed for any hotel (F05).
questions.how_to_find: Owner to state budget. Check each official room-type page (S-02).

questions.question: Should the hotel be on the Strip, downtown, or in the Chinatown/Spring Mountain corridor?
questions.known: By LVCVA area label (S03): 13 of 24 Michelin listings are on the Strip, 5 in Chinatown, 2 downtown, 4 off-Strip. Six listings have Spring Mountain Rd addresses (S01).
questions.missing: No hotel in the shortlist is on Spring Mountain Rd. Downtown hotels are not in the shortlist.
questions.how_to_find: Owner decision. Add a Chinatown and downtown hotel shortlist (S-04).

questions.question: What does '1 hour by subway or bus' mean in practice, given Las Vegas transit?
questions.known: No subway in official transit sources reviewed (S11, S12). Monorail serves the Strip only (S12). Red Rock has no public transit (S13).
questions.missing: Travel times from each hotel to each restaurant and activity.
questions.how_to_find: Owner to confirm 'bus + monorail' (F01). Then pull RTC Trip Planner times for each pair (S-05).

questions.question: Which of the 24 Michelin restaurants should be booked first?
questions.known: Starred restaurants: Joël Robuchon (2★), L'Atelier (1★), é (1★), Guy Savoy (1★) (S01). LVCVA says starred restaurants usually release tables 30–60 days ahead (S03).
questions.missing: Booking dates for each restaurant; price for two; hours for 20 of 24 listings.
questions.how_to_find: Confirm each restaurant's official booking window (S-06). Then pull hours and prices from official pages (S-06).

questions.question: What price should be shown for a couple of 2 adults at each Michelin restaurant?
questions.known: Price symbols only: Joël Robuchon $$$$ (S04), L'Atelier $$$ (S05), Guy Savoy $$$$ (S07). é has no price symbol on its official site (S06).
questions.missing: Menu prices, tasting-menu prices, tax and tip assumptions.
questions.how_to_find: Read official menus and price pages (S-06). Enter exact values only when printed.

questions.question: Which activities should be included?
questions.known: Five activities are checked: Red Rock, Valley of Fire, Monorail, Neon Museum, Hoover Dam (partial).
questions.missing: Owner's preferences. Additional options (Fremont Street, Bellagio fountains, High Roller, shows) are not yet checked.
questions.how_to_find: Owner to rank the interests. Then official pages are pulled (S-07).

questions.question: What events are happening in Las Vegas Feb 15–18, 2027 (and other candidate dates)?
questions.known: Feb 15, 2027 is a federal holiday (S10). No event calendar was checked.
questions.how_to_find: Check official events calendars and venue sites for the dates (S-08).

questions.question: Do we need a rental car, or will rideshare and RTC/monorail be enough?
questions.known: Valley of Fire warns that rideshare may leave visitors stranded (S14). Red Rock has no public transit (S13).
questions.missing: Owner's preference. Rental and parking costs.
questions.how_to_find: Owner decision. If a car is chosen, check official parking and resort fee terms for each hotel (S-02).

questions.question: Are there dietary, accessibility or celebration needs (e.g., anniversary, birthday) to plan for?
questions.known: Partage notes it cannot accommodate dairy-free, vegan, vegetarian, celiac, onion or garlic-free diets (S19).
questions.how_to_find: Owner to provide. Restaurant rows can then be filtered.

questions.question: Should the site show Michelin 'within 1 hour' results per hotel, or in-resort results only?
questions.known: In-resort counts are verified (S01, S02). Travel time is not.
